timers.guide: throughout phase one; no exact interval exposed

targeting_and_scaling.ground_platform: Local Ice Storm selects a random hostile target within 70 yards; Stormling selects a random hostile within 100 yards. Electrocute is the non-melee fallback. Squall Line target filtering is seat-based with a random two-seat gap.
targeting_and_scaling.lightning_strike: The local targeting spell records one primary target; normal/heroic follow-up paths differ and non-primary damage is halved. Current guide target/bounce claims are not a frozen mode rule.
targeting_and_scaling.stormlings: The local add attacks only victims within Al'Akir's 70-yard home-position radius; health, proximity range, Feedback coefficient and per-mode values remain unresolved.
targeting_and_scaling.phase_three_altitude: Cloud damage accepts units within 10 yards vertical altitude; Lightning Rod ally damage accepts units within 5 yards vertical altitude. Cloud placement is random point radius 80 with z ±10 in local source.
targeting_and_scaling.phase_three_horizontal: Relentless Storm's local ride selector removes targets within 110 yards exact 2D of the storm caster; this is not asserted as the live wall radius.
targeting_and_scaling.difficulty: Only local heroic gates and Acid Rain mode IDs are confirmed. No mode-specific coefficients are promoted for health, damage, target count, radius, duration or cadence.

phase_reset_credit.phase_one: Engage sets phase one, ground timers and 10-minute local Berserk; heroic maps additionally schedule Static Shock.
phase_reset_credit.phase_two: HealthBelowPctDamaged(80, damage) starts Acid Rain/heavy rain and schedules Stormlings; local C++ does not expose a clamp or client-side stack cap.
phase_reset_credit.phase_three: HealthBelowPctDamaged(25, damage) enables CanFly, stops ground attack, removes Acid Rain/too-close knockback, cancels Squall Line, destroys platform, opens draft, starts Relentless Storm actors and schedules altitude events.
phase_reset_credit.evade_reset: AI evade removes player Acid Rain, despawns summons, restores platform/draft and removes world-trigger auras. Instance FAIL clears tracked Relentless Storm vehicles, restores fine weather/default light and despawns initial vehicles.
phase_reset_credit.death_completion: AI death removes Acid Rain, casts Serenity 89750, summons chest 95386, moves the boss with MoveFall and removes world-trigger auras. Instance DONE sets fog/default light and despawns initial vehicles.
phase_reset_credit.unlock: Conclave DONE removes Al'Akir's immune-to-player flag and invokes ACTION_CONCLAVE_DEFEATED to summon slipstreams.
phase_reset_credit.historical_credit: Historical instance row is (1034,0,46753,317,'Al'Akir'); historical SQL contains currency rows and creature lootid 0. Current 4.4.2 credit/loot/chest behavior is unresolved.
phase_reset_credit.reset_window: No explicit retail timed reset/full-health rule was found in the local Al'Akir source; exact live reset and out-of-bounds behavior is blocked.

conflicts: Guide health, damage, cadence and altitude narratives are not a complete independently verified four-mode matrix.
Local ground timers (Lightning Strike 9s/8s, Wind Burst 23s/26s, Ice Storm 5s/16s, Squall Line 10s/31s) differ from approximate current-guide prose.
Local phase-three EventMap entries are initial events; actual repeat periods are DBC aura data not available as frozen 4.4.2 evidence.
Historical difficulty, spell-binding, summon, reward and loot SQL is provenance only and cannot certify the current Classic database.
